content:
Ron Futrell

Updated Fri, October 30, 2026 at 1:00 AM UTC

LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- It's hard to imagine anybody who has done more research on the UFO topic than Dr. Jacques Vallee.

>>Download the free 8 News+ app for live newscasts and streaming originals

After seeing a UFO (unidentified flying object) as a teenager, Vallee worked as an astronomer, internet engineer, computer scientist and accomplished author. His final book on the UFO topic hit the shelves in October, Forbidden Science, Volume 7: Final Report, 2020-2025. 

Vallee, 87, has written a series of books from his extensive journal of decades working on the topic of UFO's. He was on the tip of the spear on projects dealing with UFO's around the world. Vallee is watching recent disclosure by the US government on the paranormal and he has an interesting take dating back to the 1960s.

In a conversation with 8 News Now Investigative Reporter George Knapp, he offered his thoughts on disclosure over the decades.

"Disclosure could have happened in the early '60s. I remember working in France and as an astronomer and asking a friend of mine, 'Why isn't this disclosed?' And he said, 'Well, you know, I have a friend at the American Embassy who is following this, and I'll ask him.' And he came back a few weeks later and said, 'You know, I spoke to my friend, my American friend, and he called the U.S. and he came back with the answer.' He said, 'There are so many things happening in the world.' This was, of course, during the Cold War and all of the atomic questions and he said, 'You know, the world doesn't need one more unsettling mystery that we don't understand.' And that was the American position. And then after that, it was a French position," said Vallee. 

Vallee is watching the latest disclosure from the U.S. government with great interest, and you can watch his latest interview on Mystery Wire with George Knapp.
